The page lists one price for the product and no separate rate for thinking mode; we apply it to both rows. Counted as an operator launch list price by the frozen pricing module pricing_v15 (sha256 aa2afcd5a58d0c4cc0e3d6867d590c70b6ac58e971410c27faf9628f97bcf8b7, re-frozen on 22 Oct 2026 with launch-list keys added and nothing else changed; the launch-list line and the rates for this product are identical in the earlier module 81e3578f), which carries a launch-list-price line for this product. Applied to the tokens reported by the provider's API; not a base-model estimate. Over all 1,500 items the frozen resolve() gives USD 0.039197 per 1,000 decisions; the official cost axis uses the common 1,485-item basis, where it is USD 0.015531 per 1,000 decisions. COMMON COST BASIS (v1.6.30): common 1,485 items, excluding the 15 longest for every row; 768,771 input / 322,546 output tokens. All-item usage 1,959,826 input / 328,348 output over 1,500 items.
